description: This file contains unit tests for the ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandler class in the OpenMRS core project. It verifies the behavior of visit assignment logic during encounter creation, including handling of existing visits, new visit creation, and global property configurations.

classes.name: ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying visit assignment behavior in encounter creation within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test method by loading a specific dataset into the database.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignExistingVisitIfMatchFound
methods.description: Tests that an existing visit is assigned to an encounter when a matching visit exists.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignNewVisitIfNoMatchFound
methods.description: Tests that a new visit is created and assigned when no matching visit is found.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignFirstVisitTypeIfMappingGlobalPropertyIsNotSet
methods.description: Verifies that the first available visit type is assigned when no specific global property mapping is configured.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignMappingGlobalPropertyVisitType
methods.description: Checks that the visit type is assigned based on a global property mapping of encounter type to visit type.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldResolveEncounterAndVisitTypeUuidsAsGlobalPropertyValues
methods.description: Ensures that encounter type and visit type UUIDs specified as global property values are correctly resolved and assigned.
